text: Keep furniture within {count} meters of your character.
Without shelter, sitting near a fire caps comfort at {count}.
Hearth gives its extra comfort only within {count} meters.
Fires must be lit to provide comfort.
Hot Tub provides comfort only when fueled and heated.
Only the highest comfort piece in each category counts.
A Campfire in a dungeon entrance can restore a {count}-minute Rested effect.
Wet prevents Resting, except while sitting in a Hot Tub.
Rested lasts {count} minutes plus your comfort level.
Rest for {count} uninterrupted seconds, away from hostile creatures, to gain Rested.
